items.title: Moderna Soared 8% on Cancer Data. Friday’s Report Shows Whether It Can Afford the Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna stock jumped 13% on Wednesday to a new 52-week high on early multiple myeloma data and an Ebola vaccine recommendation, then gave back 5% on Thursday ahead of Friday’s report. Pfizer’s Comirnaty sales fell 29% operationally in the third quarter, and BioNTech’s revenue fell 15%.

items.title: Moderna (MRNA) After WHO Vaccine Backing Looks Pricey Despite The Rally
items.summary: Moderna (MRNA) moved back into focus after the World Health Organization’s technical advisory group backed its Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidate, mRNA-1469, to progress into a Phase 2/3 efficacy study in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The mRNA-1469 update landed on a stock that has already been on a steep upswing, with a 1-day share price return of 13.1%, a 7-day gain of 20.7% and a 90-day move of almost 4x.
